Senior .NET Software Engineer with ~7 years of professional experience working on data-driven and product-focused systems. Strong background in backend development with .NET, C#, MS SQL Server, and web development experience with modern frameworks.

I've worked across stable product teams and fast-changing environments, which helped me become adaptable and pragmatic. I'm now intentionally focused on a long-term role in a stable product company, where I can take ownership, grow steadily, and deliver consistent value.
